newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopia tenders $48.9 million in T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopia tenders $48.9 million in T-bills.

text.p: The central National Bank of Ethiopia on Friday tendered for sale treasury bills valued at birr 325 million ($48.85 million).
The bills are for the 28-, 91- and 182-day categories and are to be to be issued on February 26.
The amounts tendered were 125 million birr for 28-day bills maturing on March 26, 150 million birr for 91-day bills maturing on May 28, and 50 million birr 182-day bills maturing on August 27.
